notes.title: Public pitch - My Countless Worlds ~Enchanted Cape~
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38052172/c6ee65be128bbfcfe21c361dbbd5bc87f79582d5.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299410/My_Countless_Worlds_Enchanted_Cape/?beta=0

My Countless Worlds ~Enchanted Cape~ is a kinetic visual novel from a team of developers based in CIS region. Its story revolves around a bunch of amateurs from a certain drama club that will be faced with preparing for the local talent competition, while also looking for the person who has left them a message, predicting the death of one of the club's members, Alice.

ETA: 2-3 quarter 2021
Duration: Preview demo 30-60 min. Release version (plan) ~12 hrs
Genre: Adventure, Drama, Thriller, Romance, Fantasy, Retro
Technology: The first public demo is developed on the Ren’py engine since it's easy to prototype. Release version and further demos will be based on Unity engine.

Contacts
Website
Twitter
Vkontakte
Mail: hello@9narrative.com


Key features

 Top quality artwork
 Pairings, lots of pairings! Juvenile romance, midlife crisis romance, even some not-exactly-human romance...
 Costume drama! My Countless Worlds: Enchanted Cape is a perfect fit for those who can't resist a huge assortment of different clothes!
 An unexpected turn of story in just a few chapters
 Fanservice with a twist. Do you enjoy beach episodes where girls in bikinis play around and swim in the sea? Why not find out what it looked like a couple of centuries ago?


Plans for the release version

[] An interactive segment where you can stage a theatrical performance with your actions
[] More scene animations
[] New videos
[] Localization in different languages
[] Voiceover
